name: Uniswap
metaTitle: Uniswap Casinos: The DEX Token, Two Networks Where Supported
metaDescription: Casinos accepting UNI, the governance token of the Uniswap decentralised exchange, over Ethereum or BNB Smart Chain where a casino offers both.
intro:
UNI is the governance token of Uniswap, one of the largest decentralised exchanges, and a number of crypto casinos accept it directly as a deposit option. Where support exists, it is generally over Ethereum (ERC20) as the native chain, with BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) offered by some operators as a cheaper alternative for the wrapped version.

The same network-matching discipline applies here as with any bridged token: an ERC20 UNI address will not correctly receive a BEP20 deposit, and confirming which network a specific casino has issued before sending is the only reliable way to avoid a lost transfer.

UNI's price tracks the broader crypto and DeFi market rather than the dollar, so it carries the same kind of volatility as Bitcoin or Ethereum for anyone holding a casino balance in it rather than moving funds straight through. Support for UNI is narrower than for the major coins on this list, so confirming a specific casino's current minimums is worth doing rather than assuming.

faq.q: What is UNI used for outside of casinos?
faq.a: It is the governance token of Uniswap, a major decentralised cryptocurrency exchange, used to vote on protocol decisions rather than as a payment-specific coin.

faq.q: Should I check the network before sending UNI to a casino?
faq.a: Yes — where both ERC20 and BEP20 are offered, they are not interchangeable, and sending to the wrong network's address does not convert.
